cases.summary: Through the bridge: parent incarnation 1 registers session orchestrator-1 and works; child-a (notify, die_with_parent) opens a prompt and works, child-b (independent) works. The parent exits: exactly child-a receives one incarnation-checked kill, is seen to exit, and its prompt expires; child-b keeps running and working; child-a's end is recorded as unacknowledged news for the parent while the parent's session and incarnation read unchanged.

cases.summary: After parent incarnation 1 exits (ending its opted-in child), the terminal is relaunched as incarnation 2 and child-c links to it. A launch under the finished incarnation 1 is refused as parent_finished and under unknown incarnation 7 as stale_target, and child-b never starts; the plan's injected word incarnation "retired" is invalid_params at params.parent.incarnation, a numeric incarnation likewise; a replayed death of incarnation 1 is a no-op that orders nothing, so child-c of the reused address keeps running with zero kills.
